## RedirOperator type

The upstream RedirOperator domain: exact named tokens, the Go zero value, and explicitly validated unnamed uint32 values. Constants shared by upstream families retain their shared numeric identity.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type RedirOperator =
  | 0
  | typeof AppAll
  | typeof AppAllClob
  | typeof AppClob
  | typeof AppOut
  | typeof DashHdoc
  | typeof DplIn
  | typeof DplOut
  | typeof Hdoc
  | typeof RdrAll
  | typeof RdrAllClob
  | typeof RdrClob
  | typeof RdrIn
  | typeof RdrInOut
  | typeof RdrOut
  | typeof WordHdoc
  | RawOperator<'RedirOperator'>;
```
